scope: B200 FP32 constrained lm_head stage screen, not model inference or serving
baseline: Full preallocated torch.mm, then gather legal logits and select the legal argmax
candidate: Project through legal weight rows, then select the legal argmax
rules: No installation, downloads, clocks changes, profiler capture, or model-weight access
Root must obtain a current GPU assignment before launching
Use exactly the requested CUDA ordinal and require an NVIDIA B200
Use the same hidden states, full weights, legal IDs and buffer shapes for both paths
Legal IDs are sorted noncontiguous even vocabulary IDs, with the lowest ID winning ties
Static sets reuse gathered weight rows from setup and report that setup time separately
Changing sets include row gathering inside every candidate call
Compare every legal logit to an independent FP64 projection before timing
Require exact selected-token agreement with the full projection and FP64 oracle
Check an all-logits tie and a two-way maximum tie explicitly
Retain raw matched block samples, correctness records, versions, config and source hashes
Wall time includes submission, projection, legal filtering, selection and final device synchronization
The p95 uses nearest rank over three block samples and is not request tail latency
COMPLETE means the screen finished, not that any candidate passed or a serving gain was shown
Slower, failed or inconclusive results remain internal
